decisions.rationale: The accepted-operation record claims a SHA-256 identity for the physical raw result, but admission currently checks neither retained raw-result bytes nor their digest. That makes the provenance assertion false at the physical-operation trust boundary. The correction is one canonical retained payload/hash equality plus one mismatch rejection test; its low complexity, regression risk, and verification cost are materially outweighed by preventing acceptance of substituted hardware results.
decisions.smallest_fix: Define the retained raw-result canonical payload, compute its SHA-256 from actual bytes when recording/admitting it, require exact equality with canonical_bound_operation.raw_result_sha256, and add one focused mismatch rejection test.
